title: date_diff: compute day difference between two date columns
description: Parse two date or datetime columns and write the difference between end and start into a new numeric column. MVP4 supports days only.

parameters.name: start_column
parameters.description: The start date column. Must exist in the dataset.

parameters.name: end_column
parameters.description: The end date column. Must exist in the dataset.

parameters.name: new_column
parameters.description: Name for the output numeric duration column.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.description: Difference unit. MVP4 supports only days.

parameters.name: errors
parameters.description: Date parsing behavior. Allowed values: raise or coerce.

rag_note: Use date_diff only when both start and end date columns are explicit. Ask for clarification if either date column is missing or ambiguous.
